title: changes to nonreactive variables containing primitive values are reflected in prod, but not in dev.
body:
### Version
3.2.31

### Reproduction link
[sfc.vuejs.org/](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)







### Steps to reproduce
```javascript
const foo = shallowRef({foo:1})
```
The element node should not be updated when the shallowRef changes.
However, when other responsive data changes, the element node(bound to shallowRef) is also updated

### What is expected?
not updated

### What is actually happening?
element node updated
